root_idea.summary: The root centers on gathering something together, especially collecting it into a receptacle or toward a destination.
root_idea.development: The lexical evidence develops from gathering water in a basin to collecting revenue, while Form VIII extends the gathering notion into selecting or singling out. The Quranic noun preserves the concrete receptacle sense.

senses.definition: To be gathered or brought together to a place or destination.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence is the passive imperfect يُجْبَىٰ and describes fruits being brought toward a specified place, emphasizing their collection there.

senses.definition: To select or choose someone or a group, singling them out for favor.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic usage this commonly describes divine selection, through which the chosen receive special favor, guidance, and blessings without prior effort; the form retains the notion of gathering by selection.

senses.definition: To devise, contrive, or fabricate something by putting it together.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic usage at 7:203, the object is an alleged sign or message; the expression conveys the insinuation that it was assembled or invented rather than divinely given.

senses.definition: A water-collecting basin, vessel, or reservoir.
senses.usage_conditions: The supplied Quran occurrence is the plural جَوَابِ, understood as a plural of جَابِيَة, in a simile comparing serving basins to such water-collecting receptacles.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To collect water in a basin or other receptacle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active Form I use describing water gathered into a container.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To collect a tax, tribute, or other revenue.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of gathering, applied to the collection of a levy or public revenue.
A nominal use distinct from the water collected in the well or basin.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Water collected in a basin or other receptacle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also reported with the forms جِبْوَة and جِبَاوَة.
A distinct doubled Form II usage.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Pointer-only unit referring to جبو; it contains no lexical statement for this root.

cautions: The Form I public headword is normalized to the perfect جَبَى although the supplied Quran occurrence is the passive imperfect يُجْبَىٰ.
The nominal public headword is normalized to singular جَابِيَة; the supplied Quran occurrence is the plural جَوَابِ.
The supplied Lane primary material is only a cross-reference pointer, so no additional Lane lexical branch can be extracted.
